capabilities: Create notes from dragged-and-dropped Outlook .msg meeting files
Fill note frontmatter and body from meeting details via Mustache templates
Customize filename patterns and folder locations, including folder-per-date structures
Format dates and fields with helper fields and functions
disambiguation: It does not sync or connect to Outlook live; it only processes .msg files that you drag or save from the Outlook desktop app.
extras: For recurring meetings, the .msg file does not indicate which occurrence was dropped, so the first occurrence's start date/time is used; the docs suggest using helper_currentDT in the filename. Works with the Outlook Classic desktop app; by design avoids Microsoft Graph API dependence and Microsoft 365 admin authorization.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Outlook meetings into notes, and connecting via the Microsoft Graph API requires app code inside Outlook or Microsoft 365 admin approval.

relations.evidence: The plugin relies on the wonderful msgreader, mustache.js, and mustache-validator libraries.
